sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rahul Singh
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.
No one has appeared on behalf of the informant.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.90 of 2023, under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Chikasi,
District- Hamirpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place on 18.11.2021.
It was second marriage of deceased and the allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the applicant are wholly false.

sentences.text: been made in the First Information Report that additional dowry was being demanded.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

It was further submitted that at the time of incident, on 05.05.2023 applicant has gone to his work and at about 01:00 PM when he returned back, the deceased has already committed suicide inside the home.
After incident, the applicant has informed the police and family members of deceased were also informed.
At the time of inquest proceedings, on 05.05.2023 the applicant as well as father and other family members of deceased were present but at that time no report was lodged.

After 25 days of the incident, the informant has lodged First Information Report of this case on 01.06.2023,
making false and baseless allegations.
It was stated that first husband of deceased was harassing her and she has committed suicide due to that reason.

Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 02.06.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of deceased and there are allegations that deceased was being harassed by applicant on account of dowry.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant - Ram Autar involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
